name: The crystal answers the skulls

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest sequence · exact date unknown

summary: A mystic crystal responds to five skulls associated by the quest with Scourge that took part in the assault. Their collection is a gameplay task, so it cannot be read as a definitive list of every enemy or a complete battle roster. It adds another layer to Chromie’s reconstruction: selected remains, a remembered account, and relics tied to those who fought. The exact mechanism of the crystal is not explained beyond its use in the quest.
